name: Information and the record
dimension: the stage in the life of a record

objects.label: Items
objects.text: IS.O.A1 Items

objects.label: Works and manifestations
objects.text: IS.O.A1.1 Works and manifestations — FRBR and its successor LRM distinguish work, expression, manifestation and item.

objects.label: Records as evidence
objects.text: IS.O.A1.2 Records as evidence — an archival record is evidence of an activity. Its source criticism for history is HI.

objects.label: Data sets
objects.text: IS.O.A1.3 Data sets — research data as items.

objects.label: Persistent identifiers
objects.text: IS.O.A1.4 Persistent identifiers — DOI, ORCID, ISBN (W12).

objects.label: Description
objects.text: IS.O.A2 Description

objects.label: Metadata standards
objects.text: IS.O.A2.1 Metadata standards — Dublin Core, MARC (W12).

objects.label: Cataloguing rules
objects.text: IS.O.A2.2 Cataloguing rules — RDA.

objects.label: Subject indexing
objects.text: IS.O.A2.3 Subject indexing — controlled vocabularies and thesauri (MeSH, LCSH).

objects.label: Linked data
objects.text: IS.O.A2.4 Linked data — SKOS and RDF. The logic is MA.O.A1; the vocabulary is IS.

objects.label: Arrangement
objects.text: IS.O.A3 Arrangement

objects.label: Classification schemes
objects.text: IS.O.A3.1 Classification schemes — LCC, DDC, UDC, MSC. A scheme is W12; whether it is MECE is testable (W9 with W4).

objects.label: Faceted classification
objects.text: IS.O.A3.2 Faceted classification — Ranganathan's Colon Classification (PMEST facets).

objects.label: Archival arrangement
objects.text: IS.O.A3.3 Archival arrangement — respect des fonds and original order.

objects.label: Ontologies
objects.text: IS.O.A3.4 Ontologies — BFO and DOLCE. Their philosophical commitments are PL.

objects.label: This taxonomy
objects.text: IS.O.A3.5 This taxonomy — the Pyramids of Knowledge as a classification of claims. Its reliability is tested by the placement protocol.

objects.label: Retrieval
objects.text: IS.O.A4 Retrieval

objects.label: Retrieval effectiveness
objects.text: IS.O.A4.1 Retrieval effectiveness — precision and recall. The algorithm's cost is CS.

objects.label: Relevance
objects.text: IS.O.A4.2 Relevance — topical and user relevance; judged by assessors (W4).

objects.label: Bibliometrics
objects.text: IS.O.A4.3 Bibliometrics — Lotka's law (author productivity) and Bradford's law (scattering) are empirical regularities within stated literatures.

objects.label: Information behaviour
objects.text: IS.O.A4.4 Information behaviour — how people seek information. The cognitive mechanism is MS.

objects.label: Preservation
objects.text: IS.O.A5 Preservation

objects.label: Physical conservation
objects.text: IS.O.A5.1 Physical conservation — the chemistry of paper and media is CH.

objects.label: Digital preservation
objects.text: IS.O.A5.2 Digital preservation — the OAIS reference model (ISO 14721, W12).

objects.label: Access and rights
objects.text: IS.O.A5.3 Access and rights — open access; copyright is LA.

objects.label: Indigenous data governance
objects.text: IS.O.A5.4 Indigenous data governance — the CARE principles; Māori data sovereignty (Te Mana Raraunga). Tradition-internal authority over the data is IK.

warrants.standard: scheme rules; argued MECE; reliability measured
test collection with stated relevance judgements

sections.governing_thought:
Information science is exhausted by four faces of one pyramid: objects, methods, warrants and bridges.
Its objects divide into five stages of a record's life: items, description, arrangement, retrieval, and preservation.
sections.key_line:
Dimension: **the stage in the life of a record.** Order: from creation to keeping.
1. Items
2. Description
3. Arrangement
4. Retrieval
5. Preservation
sections.assignment_rules:
1. Place by the record's life stage.
2. The algorithm's cost or correctness is CS; the retrieval effectiveness claim is IS.
3. Source criticism for a historical claim is HI; the archival rule is IS.
4. Copyright is LA.
5. Tradition-internal authority over Indigenous data is IK; its governance framework as a records rule is IS.
